name: signal-design
about: Every block from the library pages: classes, attributes, copyable HTML, the JS it needs, and a usage note.

components.title: Hard rules
components.usage: Square corners · flat, hairlines only · color only for status and selection · transitions of 120–200ms · tokens, never hex values · one text face in regular and medium, font-mono for code · see AGENTS.md for the full list and npx signal-design check to test a page against it
components.js: No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.
components.html:
1. Square corners everywhere, avatars and checkboxes included.
  2. Flat surfaces. No glass, grain, glow or shadow.
  3. Color is for important things: risk, status, success and selection. Everything else is black, white and grey, navigation included.
  4. 120–200ms transitions and a one-pass hover shimmer. Loops are allowed; the rain moves while work runs or when the reader turns it on.
  5. Minimal by default, detail on expand.
  6. SF Pro for text in regular and medium; Source Code Pro for code. The font picker swaps the text face.
